title: Haven't been here in a while:
content: But it's still an environment that's stuck in my mind. It's sort of like these pics - but darker, and more like mall/ warehouse .. it's all cement and at the very centre off my world, under a giant tower that I've actually not been in. I'm currently dreaming in a zone I feel is east and coastal - this place is in the middle on top of some hills - with cement paving all around the outside of these buildings. I feel there's also a chain link fence around the greater area.
